setup_guide.introduction: Try the included 50-minute recording to see how audio becomes a transcript, or choose your own audio folder. You can review the Markdown even when timed playback is unavailable.

real.introduction: Choose the folder containing the recordings you want transcribed.

sample.description: Transcribe the bundled 50-minute Bdb001 recording on a compatible Blackwell computer.
sample.expected_output: A Markdown transcript of the recording and playback where timing can be verified.

run_guidance.on_start: I’ll prepare the speech model and transcribe each recording in sections so you can check what was covered.
run_guidance.web_ui_ready: Open the audio transcript and select a recording. Where timing is available, play a passage to check its wording.
run_guidance.output_ready: Open the transcripts folder in the output to read the Markdown for a recording.
